description:
Ask one prompt of AI answer engines and report, per engine, whether the brand's URL was cited, whether and where the brand was named, which competitors were named, the cited sources and the sentiment. Saved as an audit.

Billing: 5–12¢ per engine check — Perplexity 5¢, ChatGPT 7¢, Google AI Overviews 9¢, Gemini 12¢ (33¢ per prompt on the four default engines), Google AI Mode 10¢ when requested. Only answered checks bill; a repeat within an hour is served from cache at full price. Then the fix-it playbook unless playbook: false — about 12¢ (LLM usage) per answered check that didn't cite the brand, plus about 45¢ for a rollup ranking the fixes when two or more questions were lost; without it get_fix_plan can't plan from the audit. One question gets no rollup: on the default engines, 33¢ of checks plus about 48¢ of playbook if no engine cites the brand; 33¢ with playbook: false. charged_cents is what the run billed.

When to call: the user asks whether an engine cites or names the brand for a question, or wants a prompt re-checked after a fix (an existing audit: get_audit).

Inputs:
  brand — as written in prose (e.g. "Linear").
  domain — the brand's primary domain (e.g. "linear.app"); matched against sources, not fetched.
  prompt — the question to ask.
  engines — optional subset of [chatgpt, perplexity, gemini, ai-overviews, ai-mode]; default the first four.
  playbook — optional, default true.

Returns { audit_id, report_url, results: [{engine, prompt, status, brand_mentioned, brand_url_cited, position, competitors, sources, sentiment, was_cache_hit, error_message, answer_excerpt}], citation_rate, completed, total, partial, out_of_credits, charged_cents, charged_breakdown_cents: {checks, playbook} }. report_url is a shareable public report — give it to the user. Past ~45 s it returns { audit_id, status: "running", next_step } and finishes (with the playbook) in the background; read it with get_audit (free).

Example: { brand: "Linear", domain: "linear.app", prompt: "best pm tool for startups" }

brand.description: Brand name as written in prose (e.g. "Linear").

engines.description: Subset of engines to query. Defaults to the four core engines; add "ai-mode" for Google AI Mode (10¢/check).

playbook.description: Default true: write the fix-it playbook for checks that don't cite the brand (about 12¢ each; get_fix_plan plans from it). false: checks only.

prompt.description: Natural-language question to send to each engine.

name: check_brand_citation
title: Check brand citation across AI engines
